name: fitbridge

scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --strict-vars=false && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:browser

description: Self-hosted Health Connect to ChatGPT and Claude bridge on Cloudflare Workers

DB.description: Your private health records, daily metrics, owner passkey, and setup state.

OAUTH_KV.description: OAuth clients and grants for your own assistants.

SETUP_CODE.description: Private random setup code, at least 24 characters. Generate locally at https://x-senpai-x.github.io/fitbridge/ and save it before deploying.
